زَمُوعٌ : see زَمِيعٌ. ―
-b2- Also A hare that runs with short steps, as though it ran upon its ↓ زَمَعَات , (As, T, S, K,) i. e. the pendent hairs on the kinder parts of its kind legs: (T, TA:) or such as, when it approaches its habitation, goes upon its زَمَعَة, (K, TA,) and with short steps, (TA,) in order that its foot-marks may not be traced: (K, TA:) and (K, TA, but in the CK “ or ”) such as is quick, or swift, and brisk, or sprightly. (K, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
